posts.title: Morning walk around the city
posts.body: The morning was calm and cool, so I went out before work. A short walk along the empty streets helped me clear my head and settle into the day.

posts.title: The best coffee in the neighbourhood
posts.body: Found a tiny cafe two streets from the office. The espresso was excellent and the room was quiet enough to actually read for half an hour. I will be back.

posts.title: Weekend trip to the lake
posts.body: We drove out to the lake on Saturday. Still water, cold air and almost no phone signal turned out to be exactly the kind of reset I needed.

posts.title: Repotting the plants
posts.body: Spent Sunday afternoon repotting everything on the windowsill. The monstera had completely outgrown its pot, so hopefully it forgives me by spring.

posts.title: Homemade thin-crust pizza
posts.body: Tomatoes, mozzarella, olives and a handful of arugula added after baking. The dough came out crisp for once, so I am writing the recipe down before I forget it.

posts.title: First run in months
posts.body: Three slow kilometres around the park. Nothing impressive, but it felt good to start again. My legs will almost certainly complain tomorrow.

posts.title: An evening with a good book
posts.body: Long day, so I made a pot of tea and read a few chapters instead of opening the laptop. Fell asleep earlier than usual and did not mind at all.

posts.title: Trying to fix the squeaky door
posts.body: Watched a five-minute video, bought the wrong kind of oil, and tried anyway. The hinge is quieter now, but it also looks slightly worse than before.

posts.title: Farmers market haul
posts.body: Strawberries, a loaf of sourdough, a jar of honey and far too much basil. The plan is pesto. The reality is probably just eating bread with honey.

posts.title: Plans for a quiet Sunday
posts.body: No alarm, a bit of tidying, a proper lunch and a walk before it gets dark. Simple, but it is exactly what the rest of the week was missing.

posts.title: Rain all weekend
posts.body: It did not stop once. I caught up on a series, baked banana bread and watched the street slowly turn into a small river. Not every weekend needs a plan.
